title: Total influence as expected spectral size
statement: For every sign-valued Boolean function $f$ on a finite-dimensional Boolean cube, its total influence equals the expected cardinality of a random coordinate subset drawn from its spectral sample.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a sign-valued Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional Boolean cube
